title: Balgzand — macrozoobenthos
description: Long-term Balgzand programme, 1967–2019: 12 transects (50 cores over 980 m) sampled in late winter and late summer, and 3 permanent quadrats sampled 2–12 times a year. One value per transect or quadrat per campaign, at its mean position. Biomass is the AFDM of all animals of the transect divided by the total sampled surface of the method (0.08–1.83 m2). Carbon per ERSEM-BFM feeding group from AFDM x species energy content / 45.8 kJ/g C, split over groups with MARINETRAITS fuzzy scores; built with tools/prepare_benthos.py.
source: NIOZ Royal Netherlands Institute for Sea Research (Balgzand programme, J.J. Beukema & R. Dekker)
